label: late original-phase input of w (or t/m/2/0/z)
explanation: Fires almost only during the original (input) phase (100% of mass), never at t<2, at the delimiter, or in the copy phase (22 stray steps). Rate rises steeply with position: orig_idx 8 is about 10x baseline, and the last few inputs before <DEL> (to_go 0-2) hold about 88% of mass. Input-token selective: w alone holds 48% of mass (12x lift) and gives the largest activations (top examples are all w at positions 5-8); t, m, 2, 0, z are weaker, with i/b weaker still; o/u/j are suppressed. Prefers the first occurrence of the token (in_first holds 87% of mass). Precision is low (about 0.3): many late w/t/m/2/0/z inputs do not cross threshold, apparently depending on earlier sequence content that no simple seen() rule captured (excluding sequences where w was seen earlier did not help). Magnitude grows with position and is highest for w.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: w, t, m, 2, 0, z; least: 1, h, x, f) and the first original token (most: f, x, h, v, 3, 1; least: z, t, 0, w); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=1, L=8 & t=9, t=7.
